'''Pokémon the Movie 2000''' is the English soundtrack to the second [[Pokémon movie]], ''[[M02|The Power of One]]''. It was released in the United States on July 18, 2000 by {{wp|Atlantic Records}}.

It is one of the few English Pokémon soundtracks not available in the [[iTunes Store]], possibly due to difficulty with licensing as many contemporary pop stars performed on the album.

The soundtrack, along with the movie, were promoted with a television special titled ''[[The Power of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special]]'', which featured live performances of the songs on the soundtrack.
